source_description: Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu, transmitted Vol.2; Wikisource permanent revision oldid=1963110
editorial_limit: Short original Chinese finding anchors, not full diplomatic text or complete 14-star chart.

records.historical_source_meaning: The text places Tian Ji adjacent to Zi Wei in the retrograde placement sequence, then places other main stars by skipped palace counts.
records.source_precondition: Zi Wei's bureau-derived base palace
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Direction/skipped-count verse requires an independent worked-chart parity check before an entire 14-star chart can be claimed.

records.historical_source_meaning: Set Wen Chang in Xu palace for Zi hour and count backwards one palace for each successive double-hour.
records.source_precondition: Traditional twelve birth-hour branches, Zi as first
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Hour should be converted separately under declared late-Zi and apparent/civil clock choices.

records.historical_source_meaning: Set Wen Qu in Chen palace for Zi hour and count forward for later hours.
records.source_precondition: Traditional twelve birth-hour branches
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The opposite direction from Wen Chang is explicit; no natal meaning is inferred.

records.historical_source_meaning: Place Zuo Fu in Chen for lunar first month and move forward for later lunar months.
records.source_precondition: Lunisolar birth month with a declared leap-month policy
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Do not replace the lunar month with the BaZi solar Jie month.

records.historical_source_meaning: Place You Bi in Xu for lunar first month and move backward each following birth month.
records.source_precondition: Lunisolar birth month
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Direction differs from Zuo Fu; leap months unresolved.

records.historical_source_meaning: The poem associates Jia/Wu/Geng year stems with Chou/Wei for Tian Kui/Tian Yue; remaining stem pairs and their ordered assignment need full collation.
records.source_precondition: Heavenly stem of the recorded birth year
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The anchor establishes a paired-palace association, not which of the two stars occupies which palace in every school.

records.historical_source_meaning: The Tian Ma rule maps year-branch triads: Shen/Zi/Chen births to Yin; other listed triads use Shen/Hai/Si.
records.source_precondition: Birth-year Earthly Branch
records.uncertainty_or_exception: An animal year is only a source input, not personality evidence; character variants in the poem need review.

records.historical_source_meaning: Lu Cun placement follows the year stem: Jia→Yin, Yi→Mao, Bing/Wu→Si, Ding/Ji→Wu, Geng→Shen, Xin→You, Ren→Hai, Gui→Zi.
records.source_precondition: Ten-stem year class
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Preserve double-stem groupings; no inherent wealth outcome verified.

records.locator: 卷二:安擎羊陀罗二星诀
records.historical_source_meaning: Qing Yang is set one palace forward of Lu Cun and Tuo Luo one palace backward.
records.source_precondition: A computed Lu Cun palace plus directional convention
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Source's worked Gui-year case supplies Zi→Chou/Hai; placement is not validated prediction.

records.locator: 卷二:安擎羊陀罗二星诀
records.historical_source_meaning: The Gui-year example places Lu Cun in Zi, Qing Yang in Chou and Tuo Luo in Hai.
records.source_precondition: Gui year stem, using source ordering
records.uncertainty_or_exception: An independently checkable example rather than a claim about harm.

records.historical_source_meaning: Fire and Bell-star placement verse groups year branches into triplicities with two palace assignments.
records.source_precondition: Year Earthly Branch plus source's ordered star convention
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Verse-alone ordered identity and birthplace-hour dependence are unresolved; do not implement a general placement blindly.

records.locator: 卷二:安禄权科忌四星变化诀
records.historical_source_meaning: The Jia year four-transformation mnemonic maps Lian Zhen, Po Jun, Wu Qu, Tai Yang respectively to Lu, Quan, Ke, Ji.
records.source_precondition: Year Heavenly Stem Jia; classical transmitted table
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Four transformed states do not independently locate stars and can diverge across Zi Wei schools.
records.display_traditional_section: 安祿權科忌四星變化訣

records.locator: 卷二:安禄权科忌四星变化诀
records.historical_source_meaning: The verse supplies ten ordered year-stem rows of transformed-star assignments rather than a single universal table.
records.source_precondition: Ten Heavenly Stems; source-specific Zi Wei tradition
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Do not replace contentious Wu/Ren/Geng rows with standard modern Si Hua tables without collation.
records.display_traditional_section: 安祿權科忌四星變化訣

records.historical_source_meaning: Di Jie begins in Hai at Zi hour and advances with subsequent hour branches.
records.source_precondition: Traditional birth hour
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Named star and direction should not be swapped with Tian Kong.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Kong begins in Hai at Zi hour and moves backward for later hours.
records.source_precondition: Traditional birth hour
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The verse independently reports Wu hour both at Si; the source's day assignment remains a separate question.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Shang is assigned to the Servants/Associates palace.
records.source_precondition: Palace positions already established from Life palace
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The verse's forward/backward six-count language is ambiguous on a twelve-cycle; prefer explicit palace name.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Shi is placed in the Illness palace.
records.source_precondition: Palace position from natal life-palace sequence
records.uncertainty_or_exception: An historical illness marker is not a diagnosis or actionable personal health prediction.

records.locator: 卷二:安十二宫太岁杀禄诀
records.historical_source_meaning: The twelve auxiliary stars beginning at Lu Cun are counted forward for yang-male/yin-female historical classes.
records.source_precondition: Lu Cun palace, source year polarity and source sex-coded rule
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Period classification is historically gender-coded; cannot be used as modern identity/sex essentialism.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Xing begins in You at lunar month one and advances with birth month.
records.source_precondition: Lunar birth month
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Reject using solar-month BaZi month as a substitute.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Yao starts in Chou for lunar month one and advances by month.
records.source_precondition: Lunar birth month
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The star name is historical; no actual personality or sexuality inference.

records.locator: 卷二:安三台八座二星诀
records.historical_source_meaning: San Tai starts at Zuo Fu on lunar birth-day one; count forward to lunar birth day.
records.source_precondition: Computed Zuo Fu and lunar day 1–30
records.uncertainty_or_exception: No star position without leap-month and day-conversion provenance.

records.locator: 卷二:安三台八座二星诀
records.historical_source_meaning: Ba Zuo starts at You Bi on lunar birth-day one and counts backward for later days.
records.source_precondition: Computed You Bi and lunar day 1–30
records.uncertainty_or_exception: San Tai and Ba Zuo opposite count directions must not be interchanged.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Ku begins from the Wu palace year-Zi reference and moves reverse toward Si for Chou year.
records.source_precondition: Birth-year Earthly Branch anchored at Zi
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The companion Tian Xu moves forward instead, and source wording contains two separate star identities.

records.historical_source_meaning: Tian Xu begins at Wu for Zi year and advances to Wei for Chou year.
records.source_precondition: Year Earthly Branch
records.uncertainty_or_exception: Tian Ku moves retrograde; the two positions coincide only in some branches.

records.historical_source_meaning: Long Chi is anchored at Chen for year branch Zi, moving forward one palace per next branch.
records.source_precondition: Birth-year Earthly Branch
records.uncertainty_or_exception: The companion Feng Ge has its own Xu reference and reverse direction.

witness_glyph_note: Pinned original revision is Simplified Chinese wikitext; earlier rendered Traditional conversion is preserved separately, and only exact raw-Simplified anchors count as witnessed source words.
